tasks.goal: Eliminate the remaining deadline-extension test flakes on the combined journal/adoption baseline. Two consecutive full-suite runs exposed different failures: `collect waits for an in-flight grant checkpoint past child exit` and `a rejected persistence callback denies the grant`; each can pass in isolation. Audit the whole tests/deadline-extension.test.ts file as specified in design/deadline-suite-concurrency-hardening-v1.md. Replace fragile startup/fixed-delay assumptions for tests that require a successful extension with event-driven synchronization and continuous or marker-gated mapped assistant/tool activity so healthy evidence remains fresh at each intended deadline. Specifically cover healthy grant, maxExtensions, maxTotalTimeoutMs, timer re-arm, callback rejection, in-flight child exit, default-off, and supervisor checkpoint integration. Keep intentional non-extension cases fresh-evidence-free so they still prove denial. Use generous diagnostic deadlines only for lost-signal failures, not as the policy timing under test. Do not skip or weaken coverage. If a deterministic test proves a real production race, make the narrowest fix in src/agents/claude.ts and explain it. Verify with build, focused deadline file repeated at least five times under concurrent local load, and the complete npm test suite three consecutive times. Update docs/evidence/DEADLINE_EXTENSION.md with the final fixture strategy, measured pass counts, and any remaining timing limitations; do not claim CI or long-duration flake-rate evidence.
